versions.subject: Merge PR #5652 from @swachchhanda000 - Abuse of WerFaultSecure for PPL Tampering
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\wsass.exe'
selection_hash:
    Hashes|contains: 'IMPHASH=32F5095C9BBDCACF28FD4060EB4DFC42'
selection_cli:
    # change to |re|i after Sigma v2.0 release
    # plain string without quotation marks as it has to match for both ' and "
    CommandLine|re: (?i)\.exe[\"\']?\s+.{12,64}[\"\']?\s+\d{2,10} # wsass.exe "path to werfaultsecure" lsass_pid
    CommandLine|contains: 'werfaultsecure'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch>(?i)\\.exe[\\\"\\']?\\s+.{12,64}[\\\"\\']?\\s+\\d{2,10})" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | search Image="*\\wsass.exe" OR Hashes="*IMPHASH=32F5095C9BBDCACF28FD4060EB4DFC42*" OR (CommandLineCondition="true" CommandLine="*werfaultsecure*")
